Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_utr_max_seq_no number;
 temp_max_seq_no number;
 temp_utb_seq_no number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 savepoint all_clear;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 begin
 --
 -- collection date and chapter_id not present in the
 -- where clause as it might be null; note
 -- that cancel_flag is not present as the
 -- test_seq_no includes that
 --
 select max(test_seq_no)
 into temp_utr_max_seq_no
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_date),:coll_date) =
 nvl(trunc(:coll_date),sysdate) and
 nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('2.2');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 temp_utr_max_seq_no := nvl(temp_utr_max_seq_no,0);
 temp_max_seq_no := temp_utr_max_seq_no+1;
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_id,
 test_seq_no, program_id,
 insert_dats, insert_user_id)
 values (:unit_id, :coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.test_id,temp_max_seq_no,
 :banner.prog_name, sysdate,:banner.user_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in inserting in utrs');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- Check to see if verified results are already
 -- present in unit_test_base
 begin
 select min(test_seq_no)
 into temp_utb_seq_no
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_Date),:coll_date) =
 nvl(trunc(:coll_date),sysdate) and
 nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 result_status_2 is null and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 if nvl(temp_utb_seq_no,0) = 0
 then
 -- message('Verfified result not present');
 null;
 else
 -- message('Verified result present');
 begin
 -- message('Updating utrs');
 update utrs
 set (test_state, test_mode, result_status_1,
 result_status_2, tb_id, test_chapter_id,
 tb_seq_no, well_number, absorbance,
 ratio, result_dats, result_user_id,
 testing_lab_code, program_id) =
 (select test_state, test_mode, result_status_1,
 result_status_2, tb_id, test_chapter_id,
 tb_seq_no, well_number, absorbance,
 ratio, result_dats, result_user_id,
 testing_lab_code, program_id
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_Date),:coll_date) =
 nvl(trunc(:coll_date),sysdate) and
 nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id and
 test_seq_no = temp_utb_seq_no and
 cancel_flag is null)
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_Date),sysdate) =
 nvl(trunc(:coll_date),:coll_date) and
 nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id) =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id,:global.chapter_id) and
 test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id and
 test_seq_no = temp_max_seq_no and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating utrs');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 begin
 -- message('Deleting from unit_test_base');
 delete from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 nvl(trunc(coll_Date),:coll_date) =
 nvl(trunc(:coll_date),sysdate)
 and nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id) =
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id and
 test_seq_no = temp_utb_seq_no and
 cancel_flag is null;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in deleting from unit_test base');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 end;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :s_counter := :s_counter+1;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 end if;
end;
